composition: One project per viewport: still + giant name + thin meta. Next project replaces it on scroll.
typography: Oversized project titles, often condensed. Meta in a much smaller cut.
palette: Project-driven. Home chrome stays out of the way.
geometry: Full-bleed still with type over or beside. Rails of empty space.
navigation: The reel. Optional persistent index of names.
hero: First project is the hero. No studio manifesto paragraph required.
motion: Chapter swap on scroll. Image may clip-reveal.
interaction: Click the chapter to enter the case. Hover optional.
imagery: One still per project, chosen as a poster.
materials: Flat image, sharp type. Little glass.
spatial_rhythm: Equal chapter heights (1 viewport) create a drumbeat. Case studies inside can vary.
responsive: Chapters remain 1 viewport tall. Type reflows. Swipe replaces wheel.
signature_motif: Full-viewport project reel as home navigation
rejected_defaults: centered 'Selected Work' header above small cards
